title.en: CareShield Life and Long-Term Care (Disability Assessment Fees) Regulations 2020

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the CareShield Life and Long‑Term Care (Disability Assessment Fees) Regulations 2020 and come into operation on 31 January 2020.

2. For the purposes of section 17(2) of the Act, the fees specified in the second column of the Schedule are the maximum amount that an assessor may charge for a disability assessment conducted in the premises that are specified opposite in the first column.
